label: Asteroid Abundantia racing across (Jan 2026)
note: A bright main-belt asteroid crosses this field in about 10 hours. Press play on the Jan 2026 visit.

label: Asteroid Menzel on the move (Jan 2026)
note: An inner main-belt asteroid drifts about 30 pixels in 3 hours.

label: Slow asteroid De Sitter (Aug–Sep 2025)
note: This asteroid is near its turning point, so it creeps slowly through 32 frames over two weeks.

label: Quiet deep field (COSMOS)
note: A famous deep-survey field with about 200 SPHEREx frames. Good for spectra and for seeing what 'nothing changed' looks like.

label: SPHEREx deep field at the North Ecliptic Pole (18 months)
note: SPHEREx photographs this spot almost every day: about 29,000 images. We show one combined image for each of 120 days spread over 18 months.
